title: There is / there are (hay)
short: «Hay» se dice there is (una cosa) o there are (varias). Nunca con have.

story.title: ¿Cómo se dice «hay»?
story.text: En español «hay» no cambia nunca. En inglés sí: ==there is== para una cosa y ==there are== para varias.

examples.t: There's a sofa in the living room.
examples.es: Hay un sofá en el salón.

story.title: There is / there are
story.text: Fíjate en que la negativa en plural lleva ==any==.

story.title: Respuestas cortas
story.text: Se responde con ==there== y el verbo, sin repetir todo.

examples.t: Is there a lift? Yes, there is.
Are there any shops? No, there aren't.

story.title: ¡No es have!
story.text: Muchos españoles dicen «In my house have…». ¡Ojo! Para «hay» se usa ==there is / there are==. Pero sí puedes decir ==My flat has two bedrooms== (mi piso tiene).

examples.t: There are three bedrooms in my flat.
examples.es: En mi piso hay tres dormitorios.

story.title: ¿Hay o está?
story.text: Para decir que algo **existe**: ==there is==. Para decir **dónde está** algo concreto: ==is / are==.

examples.t: The bank is next to the café.
examples.es: El banco está al lado de la cafetería.

story.title: ¡Ojo con estos errores!
story.text: ❌ In the kitchen have a fridge → ✅ ==There's== a fridge in the kitchen. ❌ There is two bathrooms → ✅ There ==are== two bathrooms. ❌ Is a lift? → ✅ ==Is there== a lift?

story.title: Truco: mira lo que viene detrás
story.text: Mira la primera cosa de la lista: si es una sola, ==there's== (There's a sofa and two chairs). Y recuerda: there's es la forma corta de there is; con are no hay forma corta escrita.

compare.es: En español «hay» es igual para una cosa o para muchas (hay un baño, hay dos baños) y nunca cambia.
compare.target: En inglés depende del número: there is (there's) + una cosa; there are + varias. En preguntas se invierte (Is there…? Are there any…?) y no se usa have para decir «hay».

errors.wrong: In my flat have two bedrooms.
errors.right: There are two bedrooms in my flat.
errors.why: «Hay» no es have: se dice there are.
Tres sillas es plural: there are.

errors.right: Is there a supermarket near here?
errors.why: La pregunta de «¿hay…?» necesita there: Is there…?
Un baño es singular: there is (there's).
En negativa con plural solemos añadir any.
Para preguntar dónde está algo concreto no se usa there: Where is…?

exercises.q: There ___ a big sofa in the living room.
exercises.es: Hay un sofá grande en el salón.
exercises.why: Un sofá es singular: there is.

exercises.q: There ___ two bathrooms in Hugo's flat.
exercises.es: Hay dos baños en el piso de Hugo.
exercises.why: Dos baños es plural: there are.

exercises.q: ___ a lift in the building?
exercises.why: En la pregunta se cambia el orden: Is there…?

exercises.q: ___ any shops near the hotel?
exercises.why: Tiendas es plural: Are there any…?

exercises.q: There ___ any towels in the bathroom.
exercises.es: No hay toallas en el baño.
exercises.why: Toallas es plural: there aren't any.

exercises.q: Is there a garden? Yes, there ___.
exercises.why: Respuesta corta en singular: Yes, there is.

exercises.q: There ___ a fridge and a cooker in the kitchen.
exercises.es: Hay una nevera y una cocina en la cocina.
exercises.why: La primera cosa de la lista es una sola (a fridge): there is.

exercises.q: There ___ three bedrooms upstairs.
exercises.why: Tres dormitorios: there are.

exercises.q: There ___ a TV in my bedroom. I read books!
exercises.es: No hay tele en mi dormitorio. ¡Leo libros!
exercises.why: Negativa en singular: there isn't.

exercises.q: Are there any chairs? No, there ___.
exercises.why: Respuesta corta negativa en plural: No, there aren't.

exercises.q: ___ there a chemist's near here?
exercises.why: Una farmacia: Is there…?

exercises.q: There aren't ___ glasses in the cupboard.
exercises.es: No hay vasos en el armario.
exercises.why: En negativa con plural añadimos any.
Una cosa: is. Varias: are.

exercises.q: In the kitchen have a big table.
exercises.why: «Hay» no es have. Lo natural es: There's a big table in the kitchen.

exercises.q: There is four chairs in the dining room.
exercises.why: Cuatro sillas: there are.

exercises.q: There are a microwave in the kitchen.
exercises.why: Un microondas: there is.

exercises.q: Is there any towels?
exercises.why: Towels es plural: Are there any…?

exercises.q: No, there isn't any cups.
exercises.why: Cups es plural: there aren't any.

exercises.q: There's a garden.
exercises.why: Negativa en singular: there isn't a…

exercises.q: There's a lift.
exercises.why: En la pregunta, is va delante: Is there…?

exercises.q: There are some shops.
exercises.why: En preguntas con plural usamos any: Are there any…?

exercises.q: There's a window in the kitchen.
answer: There are two windows in the kitchen.
exercises.why: Dos ventanas: there are + windows.

exercises.q: There are some plates on the table.
answer: There aren't any plates on the table.
There are not any plates on the table.
There are no plates on the table.
exercises.why: Negativa en plural: there aren't any.

exercises.es: Hay dos dormitorios en mi piso
exercises.answer: There are two bedrooms in my flat
exercises.why: Hay + plural = there are.

exercises.answer: Is there a supermarket near here
exercises.why: Pregunta: Is there…?

exercises.es: No hay toallas en el baño
exercises.answer: There aren't any towels in the bathroom
exercises.why: Negativa plural: there aren't any.

exercises.q: Hay una mesa en la cocina.
answer: There's a table in the kitchen.
There is a table in the kitchen.
exercises.why: Una mesa: there is (there's).

exercises.q: ¿Hay wifi en el hotel?
answer: Is there wifi in the hotel?
Is there Wi-Fi in the hotel?
Is there wifi at the hotel?
Is there Wi-Fi at the hotel?
exercises.why: Pregunta en singular: Is there…?

exercises.q: There are a lot of people in the market.
answer: Hay mucha gente en el mercado.
En el mercado hay mucha gente.
exercises.why: There are = hay. People es plural en inglés.

exercises.context: Llegas al piso de vacaciones y quieres saber si hay lavadora.
exercises.why: Para preguntar «¿hay…?»: Is there…?

exercises.context: Una amiga inglesa pregunta cómo es tu piso. Tiene tres dormitorios.
exercises.why: Tres dormitorios: there are.

exercises.context: Buscas la estación concreta de la que te ha hablado Hugo. Preguntas dónde está.
exercises.why: Para algo concreto preguntamos dónde está: Where is…?

exercises.q: There ___ any eggs in the fridge.
exercises.why: Eggs es plural: there aren't any.
